courses.title: Deutsch A1
courses.description: Build a strong foundation in German and learn to communicate in simple everyday situations.
courses.speaking: Introduce yourself, talk about family, hobbies, daily routine, shopping and basic needs.
courses.writing: Write simple messages, forms, emails and short personal texts.
courses.listening: Understand simple conversations, announcements and everyday expressions.
courses.reading: Understand simple texts, signs, forms, menus and short messages.
courses.grammar: Personal pronouns, verbs, articles, Akkusativ, basic Dativ, sentence structure, modal verbs, Perfekt basics and more.
courses.vocabulary: Everyday vocabulary related to family, work, food, shopping, time, home, travel and daily life.

courses.title: Deutsch A2
courses.description: Improve your German and communicate more confidently in everyday situations.
courses.speaking: Talk about experiences, plans, health, work, travel, relationships and everyday problems.
courses.writing: Write emails, messages, descriptions, invitations and simple formal texts.
courses.listening: Understand conversations and important information in familiar everyday situations.
courses.reading: Understand short articles, advertisements, emails, messages and everyday documents.
courses.grammar: Dativ, Wechselpräpositionen, Perfekt, Präteritum, subordinate clauses, reflexive verbs, comparative forms and more.
courses.vocabulary: Expand vocabulary for work, education, health, travel, housing, relationships, shopping and everyday communication.

courses.title: Deutsch B1
courses.description: Develop independent German communication skills for work, study and everyday life.
courses.speaking: Express opinions, discuss familiar topics, describe experiences and give reasons for your opinions.
courses.writing: Write structured emails, opinions, complaints, applications and personal texts.
courses.listening: Understand the main points of clear standard German on familiar topics.
courses.reading: Understand longer everyday texts, articles, emails and informative materials.
courses.grammar: Relative clauses, Konjunktiv II, passive voice, adjective declension, connectors, subordinate clauses and advanced sentence structures.
courses.vocabulary: Build vocabulary for work, education, society, environment, technology, media and everyday communication.

courses.title: Deutsch B2
courses.description: Advanced German for confident communication, academic purposes and professional situations.
courses.speaking: Discuss complex topics, express nuanced opinions and participate confidently in discussions.
courses.writing: Write structured arguments, formal texts and detailed opinions.
courses.listening: Understand longer spoken texts and discussions on a wide range of topics.
courses.reading: Understand complex texts, articles and argumentative materials.
courses.grammar: Advanced B2 grammar and complex sentence structures.
courses.vocabulary: Advanced vocabulary for academic, professional and social communication.
